steps.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the Start Walkthrough.
The simulation walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment.
steps.audio: /audios/The simulation walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment.wav

steps.text: Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.
steps.audio: /audios/Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button.wav

steps.text: Connect the solar panel, voltmeter, and ammeter to the matching circuit terminals.
Connect terminal 1 to terminal 7.
Connect terminal 2 to terminal 8.
Continue with the remaining instructed connection pairs.
All six connections are complete. Click CHECK to verify the circuit.
This connection is wrong.
Some connections are wrong.
Auto Connect completed all six circuit connections. Switch ON the circuit, then turn ON the bulb switch.
Record the short-circuit current before changing RL.
Please make the required connections as per the given instructions.
Connections verified. Switch ON the circuit, then turn ON the bulb switch and click ADD to record ISC.
ISC is recorded. Move RL to 100 ohms and click ADD for the first load reading.
Record each load reading by moving RL one enabled step and clicking ADD.
Connect terminal 1 to 7.
Connect terminal 2 to 8.
Connect the voltmeter 3 to 9.
Connect terminal 4 to terminal 10.
Click CHECK to verify all six circuit connections.
Connections verified. Switch ON the circuit and bulb before recording measurements.
The meter reading is ready. Click ADD to record it in the observation table.
The reading was added to the observation table.
Continue recording the remaining load readings.
Connect the ammeter terminal 5 to terminal 11.
Connect ammeter terminal 6 to terminal 12.
All load readings are complete. Remove ammeter connections 5 to 11 and 6 to 12.
Click CHECK to verify all six circuit connections.
The ammeter is disconnected. Click ADD to record the open-circuit voltage.
The final measurement is recorded. Click CALCULATE to theoretically verify the Maximum Power Transfer Theorem.
The resistance and source values are displayed in the theoretical verification panel. Enter the calculated values in the input field, and click the Verify button to verify the theorem.
Incorrect calculations. The Maximum Power Transfer Theorem could not be verified. Please review your calculations and try again.
Calculations are correct. The Maximum Power Transfer Theorem has been verified successfully. Now, click on the Generate Report button.
The simulation has been reset. You can start again.
Opening the print dialog.
Measurements and verification are complete. Click OK to generate and open the experiment report.
Connections verified successfully. Switch ON the circuit and bulb.
Complete the current measurement before changing the circuit connections.
Please enter the required value, then click the “Verify” button to verify the theorem.
steps.audio: /audios/Verify button click, one value is missing.wav

steps.text: Please enter all the values, then click the “Verify” button to verify the theorem.
steps.audio: /audios/Verify button click, more than one value is missing.wav

steps.text: Auto Connect completed all required circuit connections.
Auto Connect completed all required circuit connections.
Reading added successfully. Now, vary the load resistance (RL) by moving the resistance slider to take the next reading and then click the Add button.
Reading added successfully. Repeat this process until all eleven observation rows have been recorded.
Record ISC before changing RL. After all load readings are recorded, RL remains locked.
